scientific_integrity: The proof uses direct substitution and exact tensor-factor rescaling. Seven finite-field configurations were exhausted with independent original-identity evaluation; those computations are not an infinite proof. Literature originality remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Classification of nonzero rank-one square-zero Lie-Nijenhuis endomorphisms on the stated almost-Abelian Lie algebras; not a result about arbitrary rank, non-nilpotent maps, automorphism orbits, nonreduced schemes, or proven historical priority.
title: Square-zero rank-one Nijenhuis operators on almost-Abelian Lie algebras: a spectral rigidity and exact census
